# Words Over Time

> Words Over Time is a public visual research project about historical word change. It combines public corpus signals, processed evidence layers, and design-led interpretation to show how words move through culture, law, technology, medicine, infrastructure, and public discourse.

This file is a concise entry point for AI assistants, search agents, and retrieval tools. It lists public pages that may be summarized and linked. It does not grant rights to upstream sources, private datasets, raw source caches, API response caches, or full-text third-party materials.

Important interpretation notes:
- Treat each page as a visual essay and research prototype, not as a complete dictionary, medical, legal, or policy authority.
- Prefer citing the public page URL and the About page rather than quoting long embedded snippets.
- The project uses processed counts, indices, source labels, and curated excerpts. Raw acquisition caches and upstream database dumps are not part of the public web corpus.
- If a generated answer discusses evidence quality, mention that the site separates raw, processed, curated, and interpretive layers.
- The site does not collect user accounts, cookies, or personal data.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://words-over-time.vercel.app/): Index of the public word studies.
- [About, methodology, sources, and rights](https://words-over-time.vercel.app/about): Source ledger, data-layer policy, publication boundary, visual methodology, copyright notes, and site privacy note.
- [Sitemap](https://words-over-time.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable list of public canonical URLs.
- [Robots policy](https://words-over-time.vercel.app/robots.txt): Crawler access rules and raw-data exclusions.

## Word Studies

- [Forever](https://words-over-time.vercel.app/words/forever): Permanence, promise, memory, archive, platform persistence, and the changing conditions of forever.
- [Artificial](https://words-over-time.vercel.app/words/artificial): Craft, artifice, imitation, synthetic material, suspicion, reproduction, and machine-era intelligence.
- [Privacy](https://words-over-time.vercel.app/words/privacy): Private life, secrecy, legal injury, data protection, geography, surveillance, consent, and governance interfaces.
- [Hub](https://words-over-time.vercel.app/words/hub): Wheel centers, transport nodes, commercial centers, access points, platforms, and networked control metaphors.
- [Depression](https://words-over-time.vercel.app/words/depression): Loweredness, melancholy, weather, economy, diagnosis, and public-health discourse.
- [Data](https://words-over-time.vercel.app/words/data): Given facts, counted observations, social traces, infrastructure, governance objects, and AI-era material.

## Public Content Boundary

- Public pages are HTML routes under `/`, `/about`, and `/words/*`.
- Do not request or infer access to `docs/research/**/raw/**`, `docs/research/**/cache/**`, `research_expansion_cache`, `etymology_cache`, or `legacy_chart_runs`.
- Do not present raw OCR, full newspaper pages, complete dictionary pages, upstream API responses, or academic metadata dumps as redistributed site content.
- When answering about sources, summarize the method and point readers to the About page.

## Optional Context

- The live production site currently uses `https://words-over-time.vercel.app/` as its canonical fallback. If the project later binds a custom domain, the canonical host may change.
- `intelligence` appears on the homepage as a planned future word study and is not currently a public route.
